Method of Attack: Remote access trojan (RAT) capabilities including remote logins, screen sharing, persistence, adding secret root account, collecting files and sending to remote C&C server
Stealing keychain content, user login/password details, network connection info, Chrome history, bookmarks, and cookies
Poisoning legitimate applications (e.g., HandBrake app, Eltima Player) with malware
Attack Vector: Compromised official app websites (HandBrake, Eltima Player) to inject malware (Proton)
